27. SKILL TRAINING 
 
1. 
Gist of the Scheme  
In order to ensure job placement in public and 
private sector, skill training is provided to all the 
differently abled  persons  at the District level. 
2. 
Eligibility Criteria  
All differently abled persons. 
3. 
Whether form of application 
is prescribed  
No. 
4. 
Certificates to be furnished  
National Identity Card for the Differently Abled, 
Educational Certificates.  
5. 
Officer to whom the 
application is to be submitted  
District Differently Abled Welfare Officer  
6. 
Grievances if any to be 
addressed to 
Assistant Director (Placement), 
O/o. The Commissionerate  for Welfare of the  
Differently Abled, 
No.5, Kamarajar Salai, 
Chennai – 600 005.  
Ph: 044-28444940
